signup-page.text-analytics-consent: Share anonymous usage analytics to help us improve the product
signup-page.success-email-code-sent: Registration successful. We sent an email with a verification code.

profile-page.language-hint: The language this account opens in. Saved with the rest of the profile.
profile-page.confirm-delete-account: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone.
profile-page.success-delete-request: We sent a confirmation email. Please check your inbox to complete the deletion.
profile-page.verify-banner: Your email address is not verified yet. Check your inbox, or resend the link.
profile-page.verify-email-sent: Verification email sent, check your inbox.
profile-page.sessions-intro: Every device signed into this account. Revoking one signs that device out at its next refresh.
profile-page.sessions-confirm-logout-everywhere: Log out from every device, including this one?
profile-page.role-intro: Administrators can change their own role. Giving it up cannot be undone from here.
profile-page.confirm-self-demote: Give up your administrator rights? You will not be able to restore them yourself.

two-factor.panel-intro: Add a second step to your login so a stolen password alone is not enough.
two-factor.backup-codes-remaining-zero: No backup codes left — a lost device means admin-assisted recovery.
two-factor.backup-codes-intro: Each one signs you in once, in place of a code, if you lose access to every method above. They are shown only this once.
two-factor.backup-codes-confirm-saved: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
two-factor.confirm-remove: Remove {method}? You will need to prove you still hold it.
two-factor.confirm-remove-last: This is your last method. Removing it turns two-factor authentication off and discards your backup codes.
two-factor.confirm-disable-all: Turn off two-factor authentication for this account? Every method and every backup code will be discarded.
two-factor.confirm-reenroll: {method} is already armed. Setting it up again replaces it and disarms the current one.
two-factor.label-code-hint: A code from any armed method, or an unused backup code.
two-factor.setup-email-intro: We sent a code to {target}. Enter it below to arm email as a second factor.
two-factor.setup-totp-intro: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
two-factor.setup-totp-manual-entry: Can't scan it? Enter this code manually: {secret}
two-factor.setup-totp-qr-alt: QR code for the authenticator app setup

two-factor-challenge-page.intro: Enter the code for one of the methods armed on this account.
two-factor-challenge-page.expired: This challenge has expired. Please log in again.

password-reset-request-page.success: If the account exists, we sent a password reset token to your email.

password-reset-confirm-page.success: Password updated successfully. You can now log in.

account-delete-confirm-page.warning-message: Please think carefully. Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data will be lost.
account-delete-confirm-page.success: Your account has been deleted. We're sorry to see you go.

verify-email-confirm-page.intro: Confirm that this email address is yours by spending the one-time link from your inbox.

callback-page.error-email_unverified: That email isn't verified with this provider yet. Try logging in with your password instead, or verify the address with the provider first.
callback-page.error-provider_error: Something went wrong signing you in. Please try again.
